name: Flaxseed Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Start with smaller amounts if sensitive to high-fat foods during flares.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator to prevent rancidity
Use cold-pressed, unrefined varieties for maximum nutrition
Add to smoothies or drizzle over cooked vegetables
Do not use for high-heat cooking as it breaks down easily
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids (ALA)
